name: Gone Coastal in Gulf Shores LLC
description: Nestled within the sun-kissed shores of Gulf Shores, Gone Coastal is more than just a place to stay – it's a heartfelt promise of hospitality. As the proud owner, my journey began in the 90s when I ventured here with my two beloved Golden Retrievers, only to find a lack of pet-friendly accommodations. Determined to fill that void, I embarked on a mission to create spaces that marry immaculate cleanliness with a warm welcome for both pets and their human companions. Each property, whether a cozy condo for couples or a spacious house for group getaways, reflects my commitment to 5-star hospitality, ensuring that every guest feels like family.
